text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I came to a teddy bear specialty 
shop with Daring Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'd like to ask for a teddy 
bear to be repaired, please.

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will begin the examination 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's teddy bear has patches of 
fur worn away, exposing the fabric 
beneath. ...Even to an untrained eye, it 
is heavily weathered.

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
......My deepest apologies. It seems this 
will be difficult for us to repair.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… Can't say I'm surprised. Is it not 
just the wear and tear, but the materials 
too?"

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the vintage mohair fabric used here. 
It is rather difficult to obtain.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I'll give up on repairing 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer. Let's go buy a new teddy 
bear!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this one's fur is so fluffy! Its 
wide-set eyes are so cute, too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, this black one over here is hard to 
pass up, too. Maybe I should take both of 
them home?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To an outsider, it looked as though Daring 
Heart was forcing herself to act tough.
choice_data_list: It was really unfortunate about her.
What happened with her was really too bad.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's true... Truly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I really pushed them too hard. 
This is for the best.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We've been together ever since we were 
little. Not metaphorically—literally!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Father
text_block_list.text:
"You're sleeping with that thing again?! 
It's all sticky with meat sauce!"

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take a bath with her, so it's fine! 
Leave taking care of this little girl to 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Young Heart
text_block_list.text:
""I'll do everything for you. After all, 
you're my precious friend!""

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, they're such kids. Still, they 
really did repay the favor, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, on my very first night in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if it's just past noon in 
America right about now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(――If I were back there, I'd be at home 
gathering around the table with my 
family... but right now――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...! No—that's not true. Even now... I'm 
not alone!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I forgot you were here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, as long as I'm with this 
girl, I'll be just fine!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My precious friend who gave me courage. 
Always, from now on—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I was wrong. It's precisely when this 
girl is in a pinch that I must support 
her."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"We can still keep going. Let's stay 
together more— I have to be the one to 
take her hand!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!
choice_data_list: You're going to search for cloth!
You're going to search for cloth!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! I'm gonna find that vintage 
mohair!"

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're back. Did you manage to obtain 
it, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes. I brought some old mohair.

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
You must have searched far and wide. 
Please, rest here. I take full 
responsibility for repairing it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern. Even so, I 
want to be by their side.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because they're a precious friend!
choice_data_list: She's a lucky girl, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because they're a precious friend!
choice_data_list: She's a lucky girl, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I hope they feel that way. Though as a 
result, we still can't let them rest."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"So I'll dote on them even more than 
before. I need to get them some new 
clothes too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'll put on pajamas! It's been 
so long since we've slept together! 
Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for the repairs, Daring 
Heart happily chatted about what was to 
come!

text_block_list.name: Teddy Bear Craftsman
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. In that case, I will make 
an exception and guide you to the 
workshop.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much! Trainer, thank you 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Good luck, my friend.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once you feel better, I'll give you a big 
hug first thing!
